pool.generator: tools/eval-report case-gen pool (namespace /workspace|/home/dev|/srv pool_v4, own vocabulary and phrasing)
pool.glob_weighting: Glob is weighted up because it holds all 19 remaining coding-4b failures on v3
pool.verification: Every target is ground truth from the generator; each was rendered through the pinned chat template and graded delivered-correct by the frozen measurement.py grade(): 216/216
disjoint_from: data/training/train.jsonl and valid.jsonl, the coding-4b training data (exact prompts)

trainer: scripts/cloud_train.py unmodified: seed 20261102, 96 steps, effective batch 2, LoRA r8/alpha16 on down_proj layers 16-31
checkpoint_rule: Publish step-064 only, matching the coding-4b precedent. No checkpoint is chosen by panel results.
publication: weights/coding-4b-r2: adapter_model.safetensors copied byte-for-byte; adapter_config.json gets the pinned base revision, inference_mode true and the coding-4b auto_mapping, the only fields PEFT leaves unset in training

bundles.v5: base vs coding-4b-r2, identical cases, frozen after publication

decisions.primary: v5 under the unchanged ADR-016 rule: positive tool delta, exact McNemar p < 0.05, no arithmetic or completion regression. This decides keep/reject for coding-4b-r2 against base.
decisions.secondary_descriptive: coding-4b-r2 vs coding-4b: exact two-sided McNemar on per-case delivered correctness of the two adapter arms over the identical 192 tool cases. Descriptive only; it cannot by itself replace coding-4b.
decisions.replacement: Recommend coding-4b-r2 over coding-4b only if the primary rule passes, the secondary comparison shows more gains than regressions with p < 0.05, and arithmetic is not lower.
decisions.base_reproducibility: The v4 and v5 base arms run the same deterministic decode on identical cases; any per-case text difference is reported.
